candidates.title: Full time Civil Engineering Draftsperson
candidates.company: Arnik Design and Build Pty Ltd
candidates.opening: ArNik Design and Build Pty Ltd (family-owned design-and-build, Kew VIC) seeks full-time Civil Engineering Draftsperson for residential and commercial projects. Duties: prepare single line diagrams, tables, sketches, charts, plans and designs for civil works such as crossover, driveway, stormwater systems, roads; prepare preliminary designs in 2D using hand sketches, PDF editors or AutoCAD; prepare concise engineering drawings from sketches unassisted; comply with CAD Standards; place feature surveys onto drawings and understand site levels; complete STORM Reports; assist with printing and council follow-up; complete council and building permit checklists. Ideal candidate: at least 12 months post-qualification experience as a civil engineering draftsperson; at least a bachelor's degree in a related field; experience using Revit and AutoCAD; salary band $80k-$90k. Expiring in about 4 days
